description_en: Queries whether outbound cloud traffic billing is enabled for the current account
description_zh: 查看当前账号是否已开通出云流量费
name: GetPhysicalConnectionServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region for which you want to query whether outbound traffic billing is enabled. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询是否开通出方向流量费的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
